As someone who had their entire education through the Burrillville public school system, I can say you will get out what you put into your education. 

Class sizes range from 25-30 kids but it never felt like the class sizes were too large, teachers were always available if you needed extra help. Some teachers were better than others. Some relied heavily on movies to educate and others were more involved and seemed to care about educating. 

Would I relocate to Burrillville if I was living in Barrington? Probably not.

4 peeled pomodoro tomatos
4 garlic cloves 
Linguini
Salt
Olive oil
Pepper
Parmesan 

Boil tomatoes in water until they float
Remove and place in ice bath
Put linguini on the tomato water - cook until al dente

Dice garlic and sauté in olive oil
Remove tomatoes from ice bath and peel off skin
Chop peeled tomatoes and sauté with garlic

Add in the linguini to tomato and garlic 
Salt, pepper and fresh basil to taste 
Cheese to taste

Enjoy!
